name: The Window Room
label: Illustrative sample project
description: A place to read. A place to gather. A little more room for everyday life.
constraints: Keep the window and entrance positions
Bring reading, conversation, and storage into one room

concepts.name: Quiet Oak
concepts.description: Pale oak, warm mineral walls, and linen. A calm material palette lets the light and the existing floor lead.

concepts.name: Deep Olive
concepts.description: Darker joinery and olive upholstery give the same room a deeper character. An alternative study; Quiet Oak continues into the sample drawings.

chapters.name: The brief
chapters.title: Begin with how life happens.
chapters.intro: The room already has good light and a floor worth keeping. The brief is to make everyday life feel a little more considered.

chapters.name: The design
chapters.title: Give the room a point of view.
chapters.intro: Explore two material directions within the same space. Quiet Oak is the selected route through this illustrative project.

chapters.name: The drawings
chapters.title: Make the intention readable.
chapters.intro: A furnished plan locates the decisions. A joinery elevation describes their proportions. These sample drawings are prepared for review.

chapters.name: The materials
chapters.title: Give every selection a reference.
chapters.intro: Connect what you see in the room to a material, an application, and a note that someone else can follow.

chapters.name: The handoff
chapters.title: Bring the details together.
chapters.intro: One brief. One selected direction. A small, coordinated set of sample artifacts to inspect, download, and discuss.
